//: ic-praxis multi-session module — a NON-BLOCKING pre-push reminder. It always exits 0 (a starter hook never blocks; exit 2 would). Delete this file if you don't run this repo with multiple parallel sessions. When a retro yields a rule that SHOULD fire mid-tool-use, add a real PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook here per the routing tree in CLAUDE.md.

hooks.command: grep -q 'git push' && echo '[praxis] multi-session: pull --rebase first; stage only THIS unit'\''s files (never git add -A on the hub); let the main session write docs/ + CHANGELOG.' >&2; exit 0
